payer_and_trigger: Supported self-employed Marketplace household; income or coverage forecast changes
first_paid_result: Explain current risk and one feasible action using confirmed household facts
next_purchase_trigger: New material income event or coverage season; frequency unknown
strongest_actual_alternative: Free Bracketsight and official assistance; existing CPA and paid planning suite
strongest_reason_to_abandon: Free answer is sufficient for simple cases and a professional is needed for complex ones; actionable paying intersection may be small
evidence_quality: Official rules and public alternatives verified; Headroom WTP and repeat not measured
decision: Keep diagnostic entry and calculation component; do not assume annual business
go_no_go_test: Continue only if actual supported cases prefer and pay for completed work over free alternatives

model: Client offer to household take-home and feasible proposed terms
payer_and_trigger: Individual freelancer with a real open offer and at least one genuinely negotiable condition
first_paid_result: Minimum changes meeting declared cash goal and buffer; conditional comparison; client draft; recorded decision
next_purchase_trigger: A separate offer or a new active decision season; included changes to same case are not separate purchases
price_hypothesis_usd: 29 case versus 49 season; annual only after repeated jobs
strongest_actual_alternative: Free calculator plus spreadsheet or existing AI assistant; current CPA; Moxie/Bonsai for execution
strongest_reason_to_abandon: Value depends on unaccepted higher price or fictitious timing freedom; data gathering costs more than benefit
evidence_quality: Current synthetic workflow and source-backed rules; real superiority and payment unproven
decision: Primary paid-result experiment; change ranking and attribution first
go_no_go_test: Actual cases complete without critical errors; beat strongest free workflow; collect real payments with viable support and acquisition cost

model: Marketplace income change or verification packet
payer_and_trigger: Individual with a real income-verification notice or material forecast update
first_paid_result: Consistent current-year forecast, reviewed evidence, explanation and self-submission packet; no acceptance guarantee
next_purchase_trigger: New notice, material change or coverage season
strongest_actual_alternative: Official Annual Income Letter of Explanation, existing ledger and assister/broker
strongest_reason_to_abandon: A free form already solves the job; hard cases need unsupported eligibility work or personal help
evidence_quality: Official workflow and free alternative verified; separate WTP unknown
decision: Independent challenger; can become main entry if paid outcomes and economics outperform M1
go_no_go_test: Same real notice handled against official free path; demonstrably less work; actual paid completion and acceptable support

payer_and_trigger: Individual comparing a real employment situation with a specific independent-work offer
first_paid_result: Replacement rate and first-90-days cash/benefits comparison with explicit billable-hours and coverage assumptions
next_purchase_trigger: Usually another transition or early operating decision; no automatic subscription need
strongest_actual_alternative: Hourly financial advice, current CPA, broad planning tool, rate calculator and spreadsheet
strongest_reason_to_abandon: Future client demand is unknown; precise answer may be based on invented billable hours; current full-year engine cannot cover transition
evidence_quality: Official benefits/coverage complexity verified; purchase need and product suitability unproven
decision: Strong expansion candidate after decision-business evidence; not a current capability
go_no_go_test: Recruit actual two-option decisions; verify monthly model independently; test willingness to pay against human/free alternatives

payer_and_trigger: Self-employed person approaching a real tax or contribution deadline with changed profit
first_paid_result: Prioritized applicable actions with cash needed, effect, deadline and execution/CPA packet
next_purchase_trigger: Another season or meaningful pre-payment-period change
price_hypothesis_usd: 49-99 season hypothesis; professional review separately priced
strongest_actual_alternative: Keeper/CPA, Found tax tools, IRS worksheets and withholding estimator
strongest_reason_to_abandon: Becomes a thin layer over tax bundles; expertise/support can consume margin; transfers to retirement are not liquid savings
evidence_quality: Competitor packages and official tools verified; Headroom broad scope and WTP absent
decision: Expand only in response to repeated paid-user demand
go_no_go_test: Demonstrate distinct action beyond free reserve estimates; validate scope and actual support cost before broader promise

first_paid_result: Verified obligation and next action, follow-up/evidence package, response and payment tracking
next_purchase_trigger: Another overdue invoice; potentially frequent but not measured for Headroom audience
strongest_actual_alternative: Free Zoho Invoice reminders; Wave/Moxie/Bonsai workflow and payment infrastructure
strongest_reason_to_abandon: Drafting reminders adds little; difficult debts need human/legal execution; no own channel or payment-workflow advantage
evidence_quality: Vendor survey establishes broad pain and public alternatives are verified; no Headroom advantage
decision: Reject pivot now; retain payment status and contingency only within M1
go_no_go_test: Require evidence of difficult repeatable cases resolved better than free tools; distinguish accelerated receipt from newly recovered money

payer_and_trigger: Individual with unexpected medical bill or denial and actual documents
first_paid_result: Evidence-backed correction/appeal packet and follow-up; actual recovery only after verified outcome
next_purchase_trigger: Another irregular bill or denial; not forced monthly
price_hypothesis_usd: Separate case-price hypothesis; Claimable reference 39.95 plus shipping; Goodbill published 20 percent capped at 1000
strongest_actual_alternative: Free Fight Health Insurance; specialized Claimable/Goodbill service; contest BillCheck pattern
strongest_reason_to_abandon: Generic AI letter loses to free specialists and services that actually submit and follow up; new domain and no unique access
evidence_quality: Public prices/service descriptions verified; Goodbill help dated 2023; Headroom capability and WTP absent
decision: Reject generic pivot; consider only with independent domain and outcome advantage
go_no_go_test: Obtain real repeatable cases and demonstrated completion beyond free draft; do not equate disputed balance with savings
